errors.text_span: В края на диаграмата има три сектора
errors.evidence: The pie chart actually has four sectors, not three: blue (20 или повече), orange (между 10 и 20), gray (по-малко от 10), and yellow (никога). The description says three sectors.

errors.text_span: два по-малки сини сектора, представляващи "20 или повече" и "между 10 и 20"
errors.evidence: There is only one blue sector (20 или повече). The sector for 'между 10 и 20' is orange, not blue. These are two distinct sectors with different colors.

errors.text_span: един среден сив сектор, който отговаря на 26.2%
errors.evidence: The gray sector is labeled 'по-малко от 10' in the legend, but the description does not identify it by this label and misses that there is a separate orange sector for 'между 10 и 20'.
The description fails to mention the orange sector for 'между 10 и 20' as a distinct, separate sector with its own color.
The description does not mention the yellow sector's label ('никога') or the gray sector's label ('по-малко от 10') from the legend, which are essential for understanding what the sectors represent.

errors.text_span: В края на диаграмата има три сектора
errors.evidence: The phrase 'В края на диаграмата' (at the end of the chart) is an awkward and inaccurate description; the sectors are simply parts of the pie chart.
